senses.en: to cry or complain in a weak, tearful way; to sniff with a runny nose

example.en: Stop snivelling and tell me what happened.
example.zh: 别抽泣了，告诉我发生了什么。

senses.en: a tearful, whining state; a runny nose

example.en: He came in with a cold and a snivel.
example.zh: 他感冒流着鼻涕进来了。

senses.en: a state of being shocked or unable to think clearly

example.en: She stared at the bill in stupefaction.
example.zh: 她目瞪口呆地盯着账单。

senses.en: institutions of higher education where students study for degrees, often part of a university

example.en: She studied medicine at one of the colleges of the university.
example.zh: 她在这所大学的一个学院学习医学。

senses.en: a person who follows the religion of Islam

example.en: Many Muslims pray five times a day.
example.zh: 许多穆斯林每天礼拜五次。

senses.en: relating to Islam or its followers

example.en: They visited a historic Muslim mosque.
example.zh: 他们参观了一座历史悠久的清真寺。

senses.en: a regularly sent publication giving news to a group of people

example.en: The company sends a newsletter to all its employees every month.
example.zh: 公司每个月向全体员工发送一份内部通讯。

senses.en: a vegetable with long crisp green stalks eaten raw or cooked

example.en: She added some chopped celery to the soup.
example.zh: 她在汤里加了一些切碎的芹菜。

senses.en: intended to correct or improve a problem or weakness

example.en: He took remedial classes to improve his reading skills.
example.zh: 他上补习课来提高阅读能力。

senses.en: intended to treat or cure a medical condition

example.en: The clinic offers remedial therapy for joint pain.
example.zh: 该诊所提供针对关节疼痛的治疗。

senses.en: loose and not fitting closely

example.en: He wore a baggy sweater to stay warm.
example.zh: 他穿着一件宽松的毛衣保暖。

senses.en: the elected head of a city government

example.en: The mayor opened the new public library.
example.zh: 市长为新的公共图书馆揭幕。

senses.en: able to be obtained, used, or accessed

example.en: Tickets are available at the door.
example.zh: 门口有票出售。

senses.en: free or not busy, and able to be seen or contacted

example.en: The doctor is available this afternoon.
example.zh: 医生今天下午有空。

senses.en: a person who is running for a public office

example.en: The candidate gave a speech about education.
example.zh: 这名候选人发表了关于教育的演讲。

senses.en: a person considered for a job, prize, or honor

example.en: She is a strong candidate for the scholarship.
example.zh: 她是这项奖学金的有力人选。

senses.en: finally, after a series of events or a process

example.en: She worked hard and ultimately succeeded.
example.zh: 她努力工作，最终成功了。

senses.en: having a bright yellow color like gold

example.en: The leaves turn golden in autumn.
example.zh: 秋天树叶变成金黄色。

senses.en: made of gold

example.en: The king wore a golden crown.
example.zh: 国王戴着一顶金冠。

senses.en: very good, favorable, or prosperous

example.en: She saw a golden opportunity to start her own business.
example.zh: 她看到了一个自己创业的绝佳机会。

senses.en: not common or ordinary

example.en: It is unusual for him to be late.
example.zh: 他迟到是不寻常的。

senses.en: slightly strange or different from what is expected

example.en: The bird has an unusual call.
example.zh: 这只鸟的叫声很奇特。

senses.en: having no value or use

example.en: The old currency became worthless after the war.
example.zh: 战后旧货币变得一文不值。

senses.en: producing or protected from direct sunlight; pleasantly dark

example.en: We sat under a shady tree to escape the heat.
example.zh: 我们坐在一棵多荫的树下避暑。

senses.en: seeming dishonest or questionable

example.en: He was involved in some shady business deals.
example.zh: 他卷入了一些不正当的商业交易。

senses.en: to take away an amount from a total, especially money

example.en: The company deducts tax from your salary each month.
example.zh: 公司每月从你的工资中扣除税款。

senses.en: a long, narrow opening or cut

example.en: He posted the letter through the slit in the door.
example.zh: 他把信从门上的狭缝里塞了进去。

senses.en: to make a long, narrow cut in something
senses.zh: 切开；割开（一道狭长的口子）

example.en: She slit the envelope open with a knife.
example.zh: 她用刀把信封裁开。

senses.en: the top edge or inside edge of a container

example.en: She filled the glass right to the brim.
example.zh: 她把玻璃杯倒得满满齐口。

senses.en: the flat part that sticks out around a hat

example.en: He pulled the brim of his hat down against the rain.
example.zh: 他把帽檐往下拉以挡雨。

senses.en: to be completely full

example.en: Her eyes were brimming with tears.
example.zh: 她的眼里噙满泪水。

senses.en: not good enough or not suitable for a purpose

example.en: The old bridge was declared unfit for heavy traffic.
example.zh: 这座旧桥被宣布不适合重型交通通行。

senses.en: not physically healthy or in good condition

example.en: He got tired quickly because he was unfit.
example.zh: 他因为体质差，很快就累了。

senses.en: to make someone or something unsuitable for something

example.en: His injury unfitted him for active duty.
example.zh: 他的伤病使他不宜执行现役任务。

senses.en: happening again and again

example.en: Despite repeated warnings, he kept smoking.
example.zh: 尽管一再警告，他还是继续抽烟。

senses.en: a person legally responsible for caring for a child or someone unable to look after themselves

example.en: Her uncle became her legal guardian after her parents died.
example.zh: 她父母去世后，她叔叔成了她的法定监护人。

senses.en: a person who protects or defends something

example.en: Dogs are often seen as guardians of the home.
example.zh: 狗常被视为家庭的守护者。

senses.en: plural of well; a deep hole dug to get water or oil

example.en: The village gets its water from wells.
example.zh: 这个村庄的水取自水井。

senses.en: an unintentional failure to notice something; a small mistake

example.en: Leaving out your name was a simple oversight.
example.zh: 漏写你的名字只是一个小疏忽。

senses.en: the act of supervising or watching over something

example.en: The agency has oversight of food safety.
example.zh: 该机构负责食品安全监管。

senses.en: written in printed letters or available in printed form

example.en: Please fill in your name in printed form on the application.
example.zh: 请在申请表上用印刷体填写姓名。

senses.en: having a printed pattern

example.en: She wore a floral printed dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿着一条印花连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: an illegal act; a crime

example.en: Driving without a licence is a serious offence.
example.zh: 无证驾驶是严重的违法行为。

senses.en: the feeling of being insulted or upset by something said or done

example.en: She took no offence at his joke.
example.zh: 她没有因他的玩笑而生气。

senses.en: (sports) the team or players trying to score; attacking play

example.en: The offence played very well in the second half.
example.zh: 进攻方在下半场表现出色。

senses.en: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

example.en: We usually have dinner at seven o'clock.
example.zh: 我们通常七点吃晚饭。

senses.en: a formal evening meal for guests or to celebrate something

example.en: The company held a dinner to thank its employees.
example.zh: 公司举办了一场晚宴答谢员工。

senses.en: relating to or suitable for work; having a job

example.en: She is a working mother of two.
example.zh: 她是一位有两个孩子的职场妈妈。

senses.en: good enough to be used in practice

example.en: We have a working solution to the problem.
example.zh: 我们有解决这个问题的可行方案。

senses.en: the way a machine or system operates

example.en: You should understand the workings of a car engine.
example.zh: 你应该了解汽车发动机的运作方式。

senses.en: a place where mining is done

example.en: The old mine has many abandoned workings.
example.zh: 这座旧矿井有许多废弃的作业区。

senses.en: to control something completely and not allow others to share it

example.en: One company has monopolized the local internet market.
example.zh: 一家公司垄断了当地的互联网市场。

senses.en: to take up someone's time or attention entirely
senses.zh: 占尽（某人的时间、注意力）

example.en: He monopolized the conversation at the dinner party.
example.zh: 他在晚宴上滔滔不绝，独占了整个谈话。

senses.en: sexual relations between people who are too closely related to marry

example.en: The novel deals with the trauma caused by incest within a family.
example.zh: 这部小说描写了家庭内乱伦造成的创伤。

senses.en: showing wild, uncontrolled excitement or energy

example.en: He worked at a manic pace all day.
example.zh: 他一整天都在疯狂地赶工。

senses.en: relating to the abnormally excited phase of bipolar disorder

example.en: The patient was treated during a manic episode.
example.zh: 患者在躁狂发作期间接受了治疗。

senses.en: intended to teach, especially in a way that is boring or preachy

example.en: The novel is entertaining despite its didactic tone.
example.zh: 尽管这本书说教味很浓，但还是很有趣。

senses.en: a young person who is not yet an adult

example.en: The child is playing in the garden.
example.zh: 那个孩子正在花园里玩。

senses.en: a son or daughter of any age

example.en: Their youngest child lives in another city.
example.zh: 他们最小的孩子住在另一个城市。

senses.en: either of the two upper limbs of a person

example.en: She carried the baby in her left arm.
example.zh: 她用左臂抱着婴儿。

senses.en: a part of a larger organization that does a particular job

example.en: The company's research arm develops new software.
example.zh: 公司的研究部门开发新软件。

senses.en: to provide someone or something with weapons

example.en: The soldiers were armed with rifles.
example.zh: 士兵们配备了步枪。

senses.en: a long green vegetable with a cool, fresh taste
senses.zh: 黄瓜；一种长形绿色蔬菜，味道清爽

example.en: She sliced a cucumber into the salad.
example.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切片放进沙拉里。

senses.en: the plant that produces cucumbers

example.en: The cucumber is growing well in the sunny garden.
example.zh: 这株黄瓜在阳光充足的花园里长得很好。

senses.en: to say that something is true, often without proof

example.en: She claims the keys are in the drawer.
example.zh: 她声称钥匙在抽屉里。

senses.en: a statement that something is true

example.en: The claim was later proven false.
example.zh: 这一说法后来被证明是假的。

senses.en: to officially ask for or collect something you have a right to

example.en: She claimed benefits after losing her job.
example.zh: 她失业后申请了福利。

senses.en: a request for payment, especially from an insurance company

example.en: He filed an insurance claim after the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨过后，他提交了保险索赔。

senses.en: either of the two joints at the sides of the body where the legs join the trunk

example.en: She fell and hurt her hip.
example.zh: 她摔倒伤了髋部。

senses.en: fashionable and aware of current trends

example.en: That café is popular with a hip crowd.
example.zh: 那家咖啡馆很受新潮人群欢迎。

senses.en: the small red fruit of a rose

example.en: The birds ate the red hips in winter.
example.zh: 冬天鸟儿吃掉了红色的蔷薇果。

senses.en: to have something inside or within

example.en: The box contains old photographs.
example.zh: 盒子里装着旧照片。

senses.en: to keep something under control or stop it from spreading

example.en: Firefighters worked to contain the blaze.
example.zh: 消防员努力控制火势。

senses.en: to include as a part or component
senses.zh: 包括；含有（某个部分或成分）

example.en: The report contains three main sections.
example.zh: 报告包含三个主要部分。

senses.en: something that you can hear; a noise

example.en: The sound of rain woke me up.
example.zh: 雨声把我吵醒了。

senses.en: healthy, strong, or in good condition; reasonable and reliable
senses.zh: 健康的；完好的；合理的；可靠的

example.en: The bridge is structurally sound.
example.zh: 这座桥结构完好。

senses.en: to seem or appear based on what you hear or know

example.en: Your plan sounds good.
example.zh: 你的计划听起来不错。

senses.en: to make or cause a sound

example.en: The bell sounded loudly.
example.zh: 钟声响亮地响起。

senses.en: a precious stone, especially one used in jewelry

example.en: The ring has a large jewel set in the center.
example.zh: 这枚戒指中央镶着一颗大宝石。

senses.en: something or someone greatly valued and precious

example.en: This old library is the jewel of the university.
example.zh: 这座古老的图书馆是这所大学的瑰宝。

senses.en: to decorate or adorn with jewels

example.en: The handle was jewelled with small rubies.
example.zh: 手柄上镶嵌着小红宝石。

senses.en: casual talk about other people's private lives, often not fully true

example.en: She loves spreading gossip about her coworkers.
example.zh: 她喜欢散播关于同事的闲话。

senses.en: to talk about other people's private lives

example.en: They were gossiping about the new neighbor.
example.zh: 他们在议论那位新邻居的闲话。

senses.en: informal friendly conversation

example.en: We had a nice gossip over tea.
example.zh: 我们喝茶时愉快地闲聊了一番。

senses.en: a person sent to a foreign place to spread their religion

example.en: The missionary spent ten years teaching in a remote village.
example.zh: 这位传教士在一个偏远的村庄教书十年。

senses.en: relating to religious missionary work

example.en: She devoted her life to missionary work in Africa.
example.zh: 她一生致力于在非洲的传教工作。

senses.en: to put an end to something by force or authority

example.en: The government suppressed the rebellion quickly.
example.zh: 政府迅速镇压了叛乱。

senses.en: to prevent information or expression from being made public

example.en: Officials tried to suppress the report.
example.zh: 官员们试图封锁这份报告。

senses.en: to hold back a feeling or impulse

example.en: She suppressed a laugh during the meeting.
example.zh: 她在会议中忍住没笑出来。

senses.en: great comfort and expensive things that are pleasant but not necessary

example.en: They live a life of luxury in a large villa.
example.zh: 他们在宽敞的别墅里过着奢侈的生活。

senses.en: something expensive that you enjoy but do not really need

example.en: For most people, a second car is a luxury.
example.zh: 对大多数人来说，第二辆车是奢侈品。

senses.en: describing something that is very expensive and comfortable

example.en: The hotel offers luxury suites with sea views.
example.zh: 这家酒店提供带海景的豪华套房。

senses.en: an amount that is more than what is needed or allowed

example.en: Cut off any excess before sealing the package.
example.zh: 封装前把多余的部分剪掉。

senses.en: behavior that is too extreme, especially in eating, drinking, or spending

example.en: His health suffered after years of excess.
example.zh: 多年无节制的生活损害了他的健康。

senses.en: extra or more than the usual or allowed amount

example.en: You have to pay for excess luggage on this flight.
example.zh: 这趟航班的超重行李需要额外付费。

senses.en: to move back or away from a previous position

example.en: The floodwater is slowly receding.
example.zh: 洪水正在慢慢退去。

senses.en: to become smaller, weaker, or less likely

example.en: His memory of the event gradually receded.
example.zh: 他对那件事的记忆逐渐淡去。

senses.en: the scientific study of the structure of bodies

example.en: Medical students spend months studying anatomy.
example.zh: 医学生要花几个月学习解剖学。

senses.en: the structure of a body or organism

example.en: The anatomy of the insect is remarkably complex.
example.zh: 昆虫的身体结构非常复杂。

senses.en: to change the shape or structure of something

example.en: New technology is reshaping the way people work.
example.zh: 新技术正在重塑人们的工作方式。

senses.en: fair and impartial to everyone

example.en: The court aims to reach an equitable solution for both sides.
example.zh: 法院力求为双方达成公平的解决方案。

senses.en: a sudden wish to do something without a serious reason

example.en: We took a trip to the coast on a whim.
example.zh: 我们一时兴起去了海边旅行。

senses.en: the structure of hexagonal wax cells that bees build to store honey

example.en: The bees filled the honeycomb with honey.
example.zh: 蜜蜂把蜂巢里装满了蜂蜜。

senses.en: to fill a space with many small holes like a honeycomb

example.en: Years of erosion honeycombed the cliff with caves.
example.zh: 多年的侵蚀使悬崖布满蜂窝状的洞穴。

senses.en: mixed with unwanted substances; not pure

example.en: The water was impure and unsafe to drink.
example.zh: 这水不纯，饮用不安全。

senses.en: immoral or obscene (of thoughts or behavior)

example.en: In the old novel, the villain was said to have impure intentions.
example.zh: 在那部旧小说中，反派被说成居心不良。

senses.en: the act of praying to God on behalf of others

example.en: She spent the evening in prayer and intercession.
example.zh: 她整个晚上都在祷告和代祷。

senses.en: the act of intervening on someone's behalf to mediate or plead

example.en: He was spared thanks to the manager's intercession.
example.zh: 多亏经理说情，他才免于责罚。

senses.en: a person who deliberately damages or destroys things, especially to hinder an organization or effort
senses.zh: 蓄意破坏者；从事破坏活动的人

example.en: The police arrested the saboteur who cut the power lines.
example.zh: 警方逮捕了切断电线的破坏者。

senses.en: to mix or blend together

example.en: It is illegal to commingle client funds with your own.
example.zh: 将客户资金与自己的资金混同是违法的。

senses.en: to hate something or someone very much

example.en: She loathes having to get up early.
example.zh: 她非常讨厌早起。

senses.en: to work very hard for a long time

example.en: Farmers toil in the fields from dawn to dusk.
example.zh: 农民们从早到晚在田里辛勤劳作。

senses.en: hard tiring work

example.en: After years of toil, he finally paid off the farm.
example.zh: 经过多年辛劳，他终于还清了农场的债。

senses.en: to prove that something is not true

example.en: The evidence disproved the old theory.
example.zh: 这些证据反驳了旧理论。

senses.en: attractive in appearance

example.en: He is a tall, good-looking young man.
example.zh: 他是个高挑英俊的年轻人。

senses.en: in some languages, the grammatical case used when addressing someone directly

example.en: In Latin, the vocative of "Marcus" is "Marce".
example.zh: 在拉丁语中，“Marcus”的呼格是“Marce”。

senses.en: relating to the case used for addressing someone

example.en: The vocative form changes the ending of the name.
example.zh: 呼格形式会改变名字的词尾。
